checks.disposition: supported false explicit formula with a conditional corrected candidate
checks.reason: The actual journal formula and denominator crop show2^1 followed by baseline1 in the E4(q^3) denominator. The pinned TeX writes2^11 without braces. This literal expression must be distinguished from the intended2^{11}, supported by the commented coefficient vector. Under Definition3.25's divisor-sum normalization, literal q3=-911198717/67184640 and q9=-6379061699/16796160. Restoring only that exponent gives q0=-23/41472, q9=-23/576, q12=455/432. Euler's relation for a trivalent planar fullerene with2n vertices gives twelve pentagons and n-10 hexagons; n=9 is impossible independently of an enumeration program. Integrality also fails. The other43 terms at q9,q12 sum to-1/18,47/48, forcing the proposed two coefficients1/18 and1/48 if the supplied zero/one counts are imposed.
checks.counterevidence: A fresh independently transcribed native rational calculation agrees with the frozen reviewer evidence and all201 supplied coefficients after all three changes; restoring the exponent alone leaves34 discrepancies. This is not a new fullerene enumeration. The restricted Example3.27 and n=5000 example avoid the changed positive indices and survive.
checks.repair_check: The two weight2 edits change the series by(23/1728)(3E2(q^9)-4E2(q^12)), a weight2 modular form on Gamma0(36) and hence in Omega. The candidate itself lies in Omega: the modular summands have the stated legal weights/levels, and every E2(q^d) with d|72 can be expressed using E2(q)-dE2(q^d) plus E2(q); E2(q^5) is an explicit extra. The independently justified152-dimensional space and nonzero coefficient minor give uniqueness from q0..q199. Identification with the true count series for all n remains conditional on its membership in Omega and the validity of the supplied enumeration data. No author adoption or unconditional all-index theorem is asserted.

checks.disposition: supported local general-statement error and removable dilation restriction
checks.reason: A1 plus A1 with Gram2I2 is an even lattice of even rank; its discriminant group has exponent2. For gamma=(1/2,0), the nonzero theta component begins2q^(1/4), and T^2 multiplies every term by-1 although T^2 belongs to Gamma(2). Thus group exponent does not suffice. The required condition is the quadratic level: N(gamma,gamma)/2 integral for every discriminant class. Separately, Proposition3.18 assumes d|N although its later invocation need not satisfy that restriction.
checks.counterevidence: The actual root-lattice forms A2,D4,E6,E8 have quadratic levels3,2,3,1, respectively. Taking negatives, primitive complements and even-overlattice isotropic subquotients preserves a dividing quadratic level. The decorated argument sums components of the original even lattice; it need not declare the partially saturated module even. These facts preserve the intended application levels.
checks.repair_check: Use the quadratic discriminant level and the explicit root-form argument. For every positive integer d, periodicity by T^d and invariance under Gamma(N) imply invariance under M=[1+aN,bd;cN,1+eN], since T^(-bd)M is in Gamma(N). Conjugation by diag(d,1) gives Gamma(N,d). This removes the unnecessary divisor condition; the analogous completion argument handles quasimodular forms, with cusp holomorphy preserved by rational dilation.

checks.disposition: supported need for ramification and marked-boundary refinement
source_anchors: Proposition2.14 and criterion after Definition2.15 PDF11 / journal585
checks.reason: The same full abstract C2 and upstairs profile(2,2,1^8) allow different generic ramification actions. Put the curvature2 points at plus/minus1 and the simple points at four generic opposite pairs: the involution exchanges the two order3 local reflection factors. Put the two curvature2 points at0,infinity instead: it fixes both factors. The former extension is nonabelian; in the latter the C3 squared kernel is central and the quotient is cyclic, making the extension abelian. Hence the inertia groups are not conjugate. Their quotient profiles(3e,3e;2,1,1,1,1) and(4,4;1,1,1,1) have dimensions4 and3 and are explicitly distinguished by the table. The numerical criterion also admits C1,(4,4,4), whose actual equal-angle three-point sphere has fullD3 symmetry. Completion retains collision partitions, so the two branches of the same unmarked(5,5,2) geometry in Example3.30 cannot be identified.
checks.counterevidence: Table2 already distinguishes the two C2 profiles and marks automatic symmetry enlargements; Example3.30 itself uses the different collision branches. Thus the evidence supports a local refinement, not failure of the detailed rational counting conversion.
checks.repair_check: Index by ramification action/quotient data, exclude forced larger full groups, and retain marked collision data on the normalized boundary. Inverse-stabilizer weights must be summed over the finite fibres, with residual quotient N_H(G)/G. For exact H=G this residual quotient is trivial. The triangular rational mechanism is compatible with these corrections; no complete96-by96 matrix or construction of every geometric stratum was supplied.

checks.disposition: ordinary positive integral divergence confirmed; intended regularized conclusion remains Needs Evidence
source_anchors: Engel-Smillie1702.02614v2 Definition4.4 p13 and cusp argument
checks.reason: Let O=Z[zeta6], alpha=1+zeta6 and the Hermitian matrix be[[0,alpha],[conjugate(alpha),0]]. Its values lie in alpha O and its signature is(1,1). The underlying(2/3)Re form has zero diagonal blocks and cross block[[1,1],[0,1]], hence is even unimodular of signature(2,2). The rank2 isotropic lattice Oe supplies a unitary cusp. At tau=i*y every theta summand is nonnegative. For cusp height H, beta e contributes exp(-C*y*|beta|^2/H); at least cH lattice points satisfy |beta|<=sqrt(H), making the theta kernel at least c_y H. With positive area dx dH/H^2 on a finite-width strip, the ordinary integral diverges like integral dH/H. A positive divergent integral is not conditionally convergent. The actual(5,5,1,1) root complement E8 plus E8 leaves the same underlyingII2,2 setting. The cited earlier Definition4.4 explicitly assumes s>1.
checks.counterevidence: A properly regularized lift can still yield the stated weight2 quasimodular count. After the y prefactor, its leading logarithmic divergence may be tau-independent and disappear upon a justified differentiation. The paper acknowledges a nonholomorphic correction. No counterexample to the intended regularized conclusion is established.
checks.repair_check: A complete repair must define truncation/subtraction or another regularization and justify the derivative, transformation and positive Fourier coefficients. Those steps were not reconstructed, so the report appropriately preserves Needs Evidence rather than asserting a false final weight2 theorem.
